items.title: Is Chubb (CB) Fairly Valued On Its Dividend Decision?
items.summary: Chubb (CB) is back in focus after its board affirmed a quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share, payable on October 2, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 11.
